cohort: 1632 pregnant women with GDM and 9067 women with non-GDM who delivered between 2011-2021
finding: Among women with GDM, high maternal TG in the second and third trimesters was independently associated with an increased risk of cesarean section, LGA, macrosomia, and NUD, while high maternal HDL was associated with a decreased risk of LGA and NUD.
